record.label: Order-3 consumption match (L5 class)
record.summary: The trivariate deriver re-derived the kappa5-free fifth-order class from first principles in the estimator's own Edgeworth-product-over-Mehler convention and proved the lambda3 shell's pair terms are EXACTLY the Lambda3*Lambda4 (a+b=7) plus Lambda3^3/6 (a+b=9) expansion - symbolically and to 1e-15 numerically. Term error is excluded; the shell's +5-11 percent harm on the supplied host must be order MISMATCH (pair planes at tilt order 3 over order-2 marginals) or asymptotic tail amplification. Measured tilt sizes on row 35 are tiny (max order-3 standardized weight ~9e-5 at L16, min sd 0.30), which rules the tail-amplification locus OUT for the univariate site. The direct attack is the univariate order-3 companion: He7 with k3*k4/144 and He9 with k3^3/1296, two extra columns in _univariate_edgeworth at ~zero flop cost; c-table already covers q<=9 and the two raw4 closed forms are c[4,7]=24 sigma^4 He2(-alpha) pdf, c[4,9]=24 sigma^4 He4(-alpha) pdf. MEASURED: the plain univariate retrofit is REFUTED - 4/4 rows worse, mean +186 percent (8.0-11.3e-8 vs 2.8-3.8e-8 card; first attempt was a scorer broadcast bug, fixed, function verified exact on captured inputs at rel 3e-4). With pair-only at +5-11 percent, this confirms the co-adaptation basin law at the univariate site: the carried k3/k4 are effective cumulants tuned to order-2 consumption, so exact higher-order terms double-count absorbed mass. CLOSED BY MEASUREMENT, all cells: pair-only +5-11 percent, univariate-only +186 percent, both order-matched +2.85 percent (3 rows, 0 wins), shared amplitude lambda=0.5 +1.36 percent - the loss is LINEAR in lambda through the origin (quadratic would predict +0.7), so no amplitude of the balanced order-3 retrofit pays. Fifth-order consumption on this host requires joint-retune or clean-slate per the basin law; the direct-retrofit family is dead. FRAME CAVEAT (found later): the univariate-only +186 percent cell was scored through Estimator().predict and is frame-polluted by the mismatched frozen corrector; the family closure STANDS on the valid host-frame cells (shell-only +5-11, both +2.85, lambda 0.5 +1.36, all via predict_with_native_tape against host baselines).
record.terminal_criterion: Closed: the lambda scan's linear verdict ends the family at every amplitude.
